answer: Re-attestations are stored in mesa and ripple lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 6 peers re-attest it every 19 epochs, so holding a position demands ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the garden graph. Verification costs 5 dollars and 1 days per identity, which turns a 3303 account sybil into a 1 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
